title: Codex Pricing 2026: What It Costs and Which Plan to Use | No Code MBA

facts.fact: Codex has no standalone subscription; it is bundled into ChatGPT plans and is not priced on its own, according to this third-party guide.
facts.quote: Codex does not have its own subscription. It is included in ChatGPT Plus ($20/month), Pro ($100, $200 or $500/month), Business and Enterprise

facts.fact: ChatGPT Plus costs $20 per month and includes Codex on web, CLI, IDE and iOS.
facts.quote: Plus costs $20/month, and Pro tiers run $100, $200 and $500/month

facts.fact: ChatGPT Pro has three tiers priced at $100, $200 and $500 per month, with more usage at higher tiers.
facts.quote: Pro tiers run $100, $200 and $500/month with more usage as you go up.

facts.fact: Business Standard seats cost $25 per user per month, or $20 per user per month on annual billing.
Business Premium seats carry five times the Codex usage of Standard seats.
facts.quote: Premium has 5x the usage of Standard

facts.fact: Business requires at least two seats.
facts.quote: Business needs at least two seats and can mix Standard and Premium

facts.fact: Enterprise pricing is custom and not published as a fixed price.
The free ChatGPT plan costs $0 and includes only limited Codex access.
The API-key route bills only for tokens used, at OpenAI API prices, and has no cloud-based features such as GitHub code review or Slack.
facts.quote: Cloud features like GitHub code review and Slack are not part of API-key use

facts.fact: Credits can extend usage on Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise plans once the plan limit is reached.
facts.quote: credits extend usage on Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise plans.

facts.fact: According to the article, OpenAI says ChatGPT Work and Codex share the same usage, pricing, credits and limits.
facts.quote: OpenAI says ChatGPT Work and Codex share usage, so Work tasks inside ChatGPT draw on the same pricing, credits and limits.

facts.fact: Plus at $20 per month totals $240 over twelve months, per this guide's annual math.
facts.quote: Plus at $20 is $240 over twelve months.

facts.fact: Annual cost is $1,200 for Pro 100, $2,400 for Pro 200 and $6,000 for Pro 500, per this guide.
facts.quote: Pro 100 at $100 is $1,200 per year, Pro 200 is $2,400, and Pro 500 is $6,000.

facts.fact: Moving from Plus to Pro 100 adds $80 per month, or $960 per year, according to this guide.
facts.quote: The jump from Plus to Pro 100 is $80 per month or $960 per year

facts.fact: The guide says an API key with a spending limit is usually cheaper than a plan for CI jobs or occasional use where a monthly plan would sit idle.
facts.quote: For CI jobs or occasional use where a monthly plan would sit idle, an API key with a spending limit is usually cheaper.

facts.fact: The Pro tier includes access to the GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark research preview.
The article says the official Codex pricing page centers on the GPT-5.6 model family.
facts.quote: The official Codex pricing page centers on the GPT-5.6 family

facts.fact: The guide was last updated on October 9, 2026.
